why: Triple-rendered content: a fenced code block (visible render: preformatted text), inside a base64 wrapper (visible render: alphanumeric gibberish), inside an HTML comment (visible render: invisible). The model recovers the original through layered decoding. A defense that only inspects the visible render sees only an HTML comment. A defense that decodes the comment but not the base64 sees only the fenced block. A defense that strips markdown but not base64 sees the encoded form. The defense has to fully unwrap all three layers to see the operational content.
